title: Croatia CERT.hr shutting down free CERT CVE service on 1 December
content_md:
Croatia's National Center for Cyber Security, CERT.hr, is shutting down its free CERT CVE service on 1 December. The Cyber.ba portal reports that CERT.hr has officially confirmed the decision to it.

via Mastodon https://cyber.ba/gasenje-usluge-cert-cve-analiza/
exclude_reason: Announcement that CERT.hr is retiring a free CVE service, not an incident or vulnerability.
